The net-only path is distinct from an empty-log fit; requested and actual public call outcomes remain inspectable without reading or changing the cached mined session.

Original CSV/TSV/XES/gzip XES and complete typed-table sources retain literal selectors, original and checked tables, full original/prepared native logs, actual preparation errors and exact original bytes. Original model/source bytes, exact requests, raw native JSON, reports, all table CSVs, selected native records and same-run PNML/source-XES/generated-XES downloads retain native values and exact integer tokens. All strict catalogue units and remaining reference defaults, types, ordering, errors, Unicode, solver, marking, concurrency and performance gates remain open.

The local server had no listener on port8562 and was restored with the validated Feature57 binary and assets. A fresh exact-origin browser attempt still returned a saved permission or managed-policy rejection after the user stated all settings were enabled. That attempt loaded no UI. The later coherent Feature58 native HTTP/API/production-asset checks are separate; browser interaction, rendered layouts, screenshots and actual browser downloads remain pending.

Monte Carlo fitting uses the actual native activity/timestamp option selectors. Default CSV imports expose activity/timestamp source attributes and may reject canonical concept:name/time:timestamp fitting selectors; the controls and help retain this native distinction rather than silently rewriting submitted options. Native diagnostic_interval, small_scale_factor and max_thread_execution_time are compatibility settings; the latter does not impose a wall-clock timeout. Cancellation prevents stale client publication and does not claim to stop an already executing native call.
